_notes: Every place James can stand. The key (for example 'dev_a') is the map id used by doors, exits and story effects.
scene: the map's scene file in scenes/maps/.
name: shown on save cards and in the pause menu.
district: which music plays there (used from the audio milestone on).
exterior: true for outside maps. They get falling snow.
enter: a conversation tried every time James arrives. Its own 'entries' decide whether there is anything to say.
tint: the colour the whole map is tinted with, per time of day. 'default' is used for any phase not listed.
The two dev maps are a small test area for the game frame. Chapter 1's real maps are added in Milestone 6 part C.
